P_0x0020E3: TA Shutedonias soldier. His rank rises and falls in step with his alternating exploits and blunders (though he never makes the same mistake twice). He seems a careless clown at first glance, but is in fact a shrewd man. Having lived in Langran's Troia province until about age ten, he speaks with a Troia accent.
P_0x002283: WA pseudo-persona haunting <REB>, the Solatis Shrine computer; a sentient computer virus.
P_0x00233B: Leader of a Shutedonias special ops platoon, ranked major - high for the post, as his elite unit handles many vital missions. A consummate career soldier through and through.
P_0x00246F: A Feil army general famed for tenacious defense. Once an aspiring <Elemental> engineer, he knows <Elemental> design well and spares no expense on his Browel.
P_0x0025A0: UA Shutedonias officer; a former attache to Langran with wide connections.
P_0x00262F: Ex-Shutedonias garrison captain, now boss of a bandit gang (they claim to be guerrillas). Falsely suspected over his Langran-born wife, he deserted; when she died of illness he despaired and turned bandit. A cultured man, he talks rough to avoid being taken lightly.
